evidence.observation: Pressure held steady at about 2.92 Torr through the ramp with Ar at 100 sccm.
Pressure rose steadily during growth from 2.979 to 3.249 Torr (about 0.06–0.08 Torr per 120 s) while Ar flow held at 100 sccm.
Ar flow tracks the 100 sccm setpoint, so more gas from the flow controller does not explain the pressure rise.
Temperature settled at 749.8 °C after a 760 °C overshoot; thermocouple and heater power look consistent.
Not installed, so the atmosphere required for growth cannot be checked.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-up test (isolate the pump and watch the rate of pressure rise) or a flow-step test, would show whether this is an exhaust blockage or a seal leak letting air in. Characterization of the sample does not exist yet.
